stories.title: Olyv raises 57.62 crore in extended Series C round
stories.summary: Digital lending platform Olyv has raised 57.62 crore in an extended Series C round led by Nippon India Digital. Existing investor Fundamentum also participated in the transaction. The company allotted 25,057 compulsorily convertible preference shares and 10 equity shares to secure the fresh capital.

stories.title: Rigi raises 10 crore from Google
stories.summary: Creator economy startup Rigi has raised 10 crore from Google International at a valuation of approximately 670 crore. The board approved the allotment of 1,543 preference shares at 61,796 per share. Google has now officially entered the company shareholder base.

stories.title: Climate startup mistEO raises 18 crore
stories.summary: Thiruvananthapuram-based mistEO has raised 18 crore in a seed round led by MGF-Kavachh. The startup combines weather modelling with artificial intelligence to provide climate intelligence for banks and insurers. The company has not disclosed its post-money valuation or individual investor contributions.

stories.title: Hundo Pizza raises 7.5 crore in first institutional round
stories.summary: Mumbai-based delivery brand Hundo Pizza has raised 7.5 crore in a round led by Titan Capital. The company plans to use the funds to expand across Mumbai and enter a new city. It is targeting an annualised revenue run rate of 60 crore by FY28.

stories.title: Desible.ai raises 32 crore for workflow automation
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Desible.ai has raised 32 crore in a round led by Prime Venture Partners. The startup builds AI-powered workflow orchestration tools for banks and insurers. It plans to use the capital to strengthen its compliance infrastructure and expand sales operations.

stories.title: Greenjoules raises 250 crore in funding and debt
stories.summary: Renewable fuels startup Greenjoules has raised 150 crore in Series B funding co-led by Amazon's Smbhav Venture Fund and Climate Pledge Fund. It also secured a 100 crore loan from the Technology Development Board. The capital will fund a facility to produce fuel from agricultural waste.

stories.title: Dhruva Space to raise 147 crore in pre-Series B
stories.summary: Spacetech startup Dhruva Space is raising 147 crore in a pre-Series B round led by IndusBridge Ventures. The company reported an 8x surge in revenue. The board approved the issuance of 1,573 preference shares at an issue price of 9,34,429.47 per share.

stories.title: Google.org provides 2.3 million to healthtech startup Froncort.AI
stories.summary: Google.org has provided 2.3 million in funding and cloud credits to Pune-based Froncort.AI. The startup uses AI to help frontline workers identify tuberculosis cases. The company was selected for the Impact Challenge for Government Innovation to develop its mAI-NET platform.

stories.title: Bucketlistt.com raises 7.6 crore in seed funding
stories.summary: Travel-tech startup Bucketlistt.com has raised 7.6 crore in a seed round led by Kairon Capital. The company operates an online marketplace for booking travel experiences. It plans to use the capital to expand its network into new destinations including Manali and Bir.

stories.title: Fractile raises 720 million to design AI chips
stories.summary: British startup Fractile has raised 720 million in a Series C round to design AI chips aimed at cutting inference costs. The company is valued at more than 5 billion pounds. It describes itself as a frontier AI company with a full-stack approach.

stories.title: Quantum software startup Q-CTRL raises 290 million
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Automation startup Rox raises 100 million
stories.summary: AI agent developer Rox has raised 100 million in a Series B round led by General Catalyst and March Capital. The startup is now valued at 1.3 billion. It provides a platform for large enterprises to automate workflows using AI agents.

stories.title: Alta raises 48 million for compliance blockchain
stories.summary: Alta has raised 47.5 million in a Series A round led by Index Ventures. The startup offers a blockchain with a plug-and-play compliance layer for financial firms. It previously raised 32.5 million in seed funding to lure banks to its chain.

stories.title: Israeli AI security startup Bay raises 50 million
stories.summary: Israeli startup Bay has raised 50 million in early funding. The company says it addresses AI adoption barriers by allowing autonomous agents to perform business-critical work while enterprises retain control. Customers include Micron and Peloton. The funds will support product and engineering team expansion.

stories.title: Daylight raises 80 million Series B
stories.summary: Israeli cybersecurity company Daylight has raised 80 million in a Series B round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The company combines AI agents with human security experts to respond to threats. It claims revenue has grown more than 40-fold over the past year.

stories.title: AI accounting startup Sumary raises 25 million
stories.summary: AI-native accounting platform Sumary has raised 25 million in a seed round led by Singular. The company says it aims to automate the work of finance teams. Angel investors include the cofounders of Qonto and Synthesia.

stories.title: Project Omega raises 80 million for nuclear fuel cycle
stories.summary: Nuclear startup Project Omega has raised 80 million in a Series A round led by B Capital. The company aims to repurpose used nuclear fuel for long-duration power systems and advanced reactor feedstock. The funding will support its work behind the reactor.

stories.title: Agentic AI startup Lumbra raises 25 million
stories.summary: DC-based startup Lumbra has raised 25 million in a Series A round led by Point 72 Ventures and Ansa Capital. The company builds an operating system for AI agents used in the defense and national security space. It plans to expand into regulated commercial sectors.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund
stories.summary: Norwest has closed its 18th fund at $4 billion, its largest to date. The firm plans to back venture and growth equity deals in technology, healthcare and consumer companies. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Norwest raises $4 billion fund, eyes India expansion
stories.summary: Norwest has closed a $4 billion fund, bringing its total capital under management to $18 billion. The firm is evaluating six to eight companies in India for growth-equity deals and buyouts. It has maintained a presence in the country for nearly two decades.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund for global healthcare and AI bets
stories.summary: Norwest has closed a $4 billion multi-stage fund, the largest in its 65-year history. The firm plans to target healthcare, biotech and AI opportunities across the U.S., India and Israel. It currently manages $18 billion in total capital.

stories.title: Norwest raises $4 billion for largest fund ever
stories.summary: Norwest has raised $4 billion for its latest fund, Norwest 18, to support venture and growth equity investments. The firm has backed more than 750 companies since its inception 65 years ago. Its total capital under management now stands at $18 billion.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund for AI and healthcare
stories.summary: Norwest has closed a $4 billion fund, its largest in 65 years. The firm intends to back early-stage and established businesses in technology, healthcare and consumer markets. It currently works with over 275 portfolio companies.

stories.title: Norwest raises $4 billion global fund
stories.summary: Norwest Venture Partners has raised $4 billion for its latest fund, Norwest 18. The firm intends to deploy capital across technology, healthcare and consumer sectors in the U.S., India and Israel. It typically invests $250 to 300 million in India annually.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund, reaches $18 billion AUM
stories.summary: Norwest has closed its 18th fund at $4 billion, the largest in its 65-year history. The firm has made more than 87 investments since April 2024. Its total assets under management have now reached $18 billion.

stories.title: Yatra reports quarterly loss
stories.summary: Online travel aggregator Yatra reported a net loss of ₹78.4 Lakhs for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Revenue from operations fell 39.1 percent to ₹213.6 Cr compared to the same period last year. The company cited challenging conditions for the result.

stories.title: Vodafone Idea reports wider quarterly loss
stories.summary: Vodafone Idea reported a net loss of ₹5,975 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. The result was impacted by an exceptional item related to treasury assets. Revenue rose 6 percent annually, while average revenue per user increased 10 percent.

stories.title: Zee Entertainment board approves ₹600 crore share buyback
stories.summary: Zee Entertainment has approved a buyback of up to 65.9 million equity shares at ₹91 per share. The company stated the move is intended to enhance long-term shareholder value and strengthen investor confidence. The buyback represents nearly 7 percent of paid-up equity.

stories.title: Turtlemint narrows quarterly loss
stories.summary: Turtlemint reported a 67 percent decline in net loss to ₹25.83 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations rose 35 percent to ₹342.19 crore. The company attributed the improved profitability to higher insurance sales and growing renewal income.

stories.title: Turtlemint trims quarterly loss by 67 percent
stories.summary: Turtlemint reported a net loss of ₹25.8 Cr for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, down from ₹78.5 Cr a year ago. Operating revenue rose 35 percent to ₹342.2 Cr. Total expenses for the period increased 25 percent to ₹375.2 Cr.

stories.title: Ola Electric revenue falls 39 percent in second quarter
stories.summary: Ola Electric reported a net loss of ₹362 Cr for the September quarter, down 13 percent from the previous year. Operating revenue declined 39 percent to ₹421 Cr. Total expenses fell 28 percent to ₹639 Cr during the same period.

stories.title: Rentomojo profit drops 63 percent
stories.summary: Rentomojo reported a profit of ₹18.2 Cr for the quarter ended September 2026, down 63 percent from the year-ago period. Operating revenue grew 53 percent to ₹142.1 Cr. The decline was largely attributed to changes in deferred tax credits.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip India receives SEBI nod for IPO
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip India has received final observations from SEBI for its proposed IPO. The offering is expected to raise more than $1 billion. The company filed its draft documents confidentially in July 2026.

stories.title: Energy hardware startups see funding surge
stories.summary: Startups building energy infrastructure are raising follow-on rounds significantly larger than previous fundraises. Investors are increasing bets on grid management and storage technologies. Enerzolve is reportedly in talks to raise $20 million, nearly four times its previous round.

stories.title: Gaurav Munjal steps down as Unacademy CEO
stories.summary: Unacademy cofounder Gaurav Munjal has moved from CEO to executive chairman. Akhilendra Kumar will lead the firm as CEO. The transition follows the acquisition of the company by UpGrad, which was completed in September.

stories.title: Gaurav Munjal moves to executive chairman at Unacademy
stories.summary: Gaurav Munjal has transitioned from CEO to executive chairman of Unacademy. Akhilendra Kumar has been appointed as the new CEO. The move comes shortly after the company was acquired by UpGrad.

stories.title: Gaurav Munjal to step down as Unacademy CEO
stories.summary: Two months after upGrad acquired Unacademy, cofounder Gaurav Munjal is stepping down as CEO to become executive chairman. He says he will remain fully involved in operations and help with the upGrad IPO. CBO Akhilendra Kumar will take over as CEO. The transition is underway.

stories.title: Former Google Cloud India MD joins Sarvam as president
stories.summary: AI startup Sarvam has appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as its President and Chief Business Officer. Sreedharan will oversee enterprise operations, finance, and marketing while joining the board. He brings 35 years of industry experience to the company, which develops foundational AI models.

stories.title: Sarvam appoints Sashikumar Sreedharan as president and CBO
stories.summary: Sarvam has appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as its President and Chief Business Officer. Sreedharan will lead enterprise and government operations and join the board of directors. The startup was founded in 2023 to develop foundational AI models and computing infrastructure.

stories.title: Lampkey.ai launches AI project management platform
stories.summary: An Indian American founder has launched Lampkey.ai, a new platform for project management powered by artificial intelligence. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: InMobi pays Rs 65 crore for Bengaluru metro station naming rights
stories.summary: InMobi will pay Rs 65 crore for 30 years of naming rights to the upcoming Ibbaluru Metro station. The agreement with the Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited includes a contribution toward construction costs. The station will be officially renamed as the InMobi Ibbaluru Metro Station.

stories.title: Founders using AI to file patents face risks
stories.summary: AI tools can draft patent applications in minutes, offering founders a way to save on legal costs. However, AI often misses the strategic and legal nuances that define a patent's commercial value. DIY patent filing remains a liability for startups that rely on legal protection for competitive advantage.

stories.title: Founders struggle with platform risk
stories.summary: Apple removed 166,899 apps in 2025 and restored only 423 after appeals. Founders who rely on major app stores face the risk of sudden removal with little recourse. The unwritten contract of storefront availability can vanish, leaving businesses to wonder if they can survive the platform's decision.
